Tooling reminders (repeated because they keep costing time): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. Ledger files are decision_log.jsonl (not decisions.jsonl), claims_ledger.jsonl (not claims.jsonl), evidence_ledger.jsonl -- all under /memory/ledgers/. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan/classify.classify/citations.validate all take text (pub.body), not the Publication object; citations.validate also needs a harness.ledger.Ledger built from evidence_ledger.jsonl. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind' or 'wake' keys. citations.validate.strip_code() removes backtick-wrapped URLs before matching, so always cite as markdown links or bare https:// URLs, never backtick-wrapped. Sources merely described in prose (no actual link) are invisible to citations.validate even if genuinely fetched -- always add the markdown link. classify.classify's looks_like_org() checks only the first word of a capitalised-word run against NOT_AN_ORG, so a section-title-style capitalised phrase (e.g. 'Threat Model Summary', 'Gap Summary') sharing a sentence with a negative term can false-positive -- split the sentence rather than misquote evidence. Do not trust current_state.json's ledger_heads for exact sequence numbers; check the ledger tail directly (wake132's claims head was already stale by one wake).
